items.title: AIG reports 13% rise in international commercial net premiums for third quarter
items.summary: AIG's international commercial book saw net premiums rise 13% to US$2.4 billion in the third quarter, contrasting with a tougher period in North America.

items.title: Argenta review finds lower-rated Lloyd's syndicates planning fastest growth for 2027
items.summary: Argenta's review of 2027 Lloyd's business plans indicates that syndicates rated lowest are planning the most aggressive new business growth.

items.title: UK government to bring business energy brokers under Ofgem regulation
items.summary: The UK government announced plans to bring business energy brokers under Ofgem's remit through the energy independence bill.

items.title: FCA finalises rules to bring ESG rating providers into UK regulatory perimeter
items.summary: UK providers of environmental, social and governance ratings face mandatory Financial Conduct Authority authorisation starting in June 2028 under newly published rules.
